```artifact
Feature: GUI Display Requirements

  Scenario: Display Patient Pressure
    Given the controller provides patient pressure data
    When the GUI displays the patient pressure
    Then the GUI displays the patient pressure measured at the gas outlet port

  Scenario: GUI Graph Refresh Rate
    Given the GUI graph refresh rate is set to 20 Hz
    When the GUI graph is updated
    Then the GUI graph is updated at a rate of at least 20 Hz

  Scenario: GUI Graph Duration
    Given the GUI graph duration is set to 30 seconds
    When the GUI graph is updated
    Then the GUI graph is displayed for 30 seconds

  Scenario: Display Inspiratory Tidal Volume
    Given the inspiratory tidal volume is set to 500 mL
    When the GUI displays the inspiratory tidal volume
    Then the GUI displays the inspiratory tidal volume with a resolution of 1 mL

  Scenario: Display Ratio of Inspiration Time to Expiration Time
    Given the ratio of inspiration time to expiration time is set to 5:1
    When the GUI displays the ratio of inspiration time to expiration time
    Then the GUI displays the ratio with a resolution of 0.1 for values under 10 and 1 for values over 10

  Scenario: Display PEEP
    Given the PEEP is set to 5 cmH2O
    When the GUI displays the PEEP
    Then the GUI displays the PEEP in increments of 1 cmH2O

  Scenario: Display Graph of Volume Provided to Patient
    Given the GUI graph displays the volume provided to the patient
    When the GUI graph is updated
    Then the GUI graph displays the volume provided to the patient

  Scenario: Display Flow Rate Provided to Patient
    Given the flow rate provided to the patient is set to 10 L/min
    When the GUI displays the flow rate provided to the patient
    Then the GUI displays the flow rate with a duration of 30 seconds updated at a rate of at least 20 Hz and units of liters/minute

  Scenario Outline: GUI Display Requirements with Examples
    Given the controller provides patient pressure data
    And the GUI graph refresh rate is set to 20 Hz
    And the GUI graph duration is set to 30 seconds
    And the inspiratory tidal volume is set to <inspiratory tidal volume>
    And the ratio of inspiration time to expiration time is set to <ratio of inspiration time to expiration time>
    And the PEEP is set to <PEEP>
    And the flow rate provided to the patient is set to <flow rate provided to the patient>
    When the GUI displays the patient pressure, inspiratory tidal volume, ratio of inspiration time to expiration time, PEEP, and flow rate provided to the patient
    Then the GUI displays the patient pressure measured at the gas outlet port, inspiratory tidal volume with a resolution of 1 mL, ratio with a resolution of 0.1 for values under 10 and 1 for values over 10, PEEP in increments of 1 cmH2O, and flow rate with a duration of 30 seconds updated at a rate of at least 20 Hz and units of liters/minute

    Examples:
      | inspiratory tidal volume | ratio of inspiration time to expiration time | PEEP | flow rate provided to the patient |
      | 0 mL                      | 10:1                                    | 0 cmH2O | 0 L/min                         |
      | 1000 mL                   | 1:200                                  | 10 cmH2O | 20 L/min                        |
      | 500 mL                    | 5:1                                    | 5 cmH2O | 10 L/min                        |
```
